if not value['states']: return value['states']
	
	#With exactly one asset selected, dim the states not linked to it, and the categories with nothing linked underneath
	linkedIds = None
	if len(value['assetIdList']) == 1 and value['assetStates'] is not None:
		assetStates = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(value['assetStates'])
		linkedIds = set([row['stateId'] for row in assetStates if row.get('linkEnabled', True)])
	linkedPaths = set()
	unlinkedStyle = system.util.jsonEncode({'opacity': 0.5})
	
	#The nine tool statuses (state type Tooling, no category) go in a "Tool statuses" folder, not among the site's states: they're
	#Kanoa's, for tools only (868mwzgc8). A path only the tree uses; selecting the folder selects nothing (stateSelected)
	toolFolder = 'Tool statuses'
	toolingTypeId = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('stateTypeId', system.kanoa.asset.getStateType({'stateTypeName': 'Tooling'}))
	toolStatuses = False
	
	headers = ["stateId","stateName","statePath","stateCategoryId","stateCategoryName","stateCategoryPath","stateTypeName","iconPath","enabled","iconColor","nodeStyle"]
	
	rows = []
	for row in system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(value['states']):
		iconColor = row["stateColor"] or row["stateTypeColor"] if row["enabled"] else '--kcGray-50'
		if toolingTypeId is not None and row["stateTypeId"] == toolingTypeId and row["stateCategoryId"] is None:
			row["statePath"] = toolFolder + '\\' + row["stateName"]
			toolStatuses = True
		nodeStyle = None
		if linkedIds is not None:
			if row["stateId"] in linkedIds:
				sections = (row["statePath"] or '').split('\\')
				for i in range(1, len(sections)): linkedPaths.add('\\'.join(sections[:i]))
			else: nodeStyle = unlinkedStyle
		rows.append([row["stateId"], row["stateName"], row["statePath"], row["stateCategoryId"], row["stateCategoryName"], row["stateCategoryPath"], row["stateTypeName"], row["iconPath"], row["enabled"], iconColor, nodeStyle])
	
	for row in system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.asset.getStateCategory({})):
		iconColor = '--kcGray-50' if not row["enabled"] else None
		nodeStyle = unlinkedStyle if linkedIds is not None and row["stateCategoryPath"] not in linkedPaths else None
		rows.append([None, None, row["stateCategoryPath"], row["stateCategoryId"], row["stateCategoryName"], row["stateCategoryPath"], None, None, row["enabled"], iconColor, nodeStyle])
	
	if toolStatuses: rows.append([None, None, toolFolder, None, None, None, None, None, True, None, None])
	
	return system.dataset.toDataSet(headers, rows)

customMethods.script:
system.perspective.print("linkAssetStates() called")

	userId = self.view.custom.security.userId
	assetId = self.view.params.values.assetIdList[0]
	stateSelection = self.view.custom.states.selection
	
	data = system.kanoa.asset.getAssetStates({'assetId': assetId})
	stateCodeList = list(set([row['stateCode'] for row in data if row['stateCode']]))
	stateCodeList.sort()
	stateCodeList = list(stateCodeList)
	assetStates = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToDict(data, 'stateId', None)

	stateIds = []
	stateCodes = []

	stateIdList = stateSelection['stateIds']
	for stateCategoryPath in stateSelection['stateCategoryPaths']:
		stateIdList += [row['stateId'] for row in system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.asset.getStates({'stateCategoryPath': stateCategoryPath + '%', 'enabled': True}))]	
	
	stateIdList = list(set(stateIdList))
	#Unknown State is linked only to a code recorded with no link, never by hand: it can't be selectable (868mw5ug5)
	unknownIds = [row['stateId'] for row in system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.asset.getStates({'stateName': 'Unknown State', 'reservedBySystem': True}))]
	if [s for s in stateIdList if s in unknownIds]:
		stateIdList = [s for s in stateIdList if s not in unknownIds]
		self.toast({'type': 'warning', 'message': "Unknown State can't be linked by hand: operators shouldn't pick it. Kanoa links a code to it when the code has no state."})

	#The tool statuses are linked to tools only, by Kanoa (868mwzgc8)
	toolIds = [row['stateId'] for row in system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.asset.getStates({'stateTypeName': 'Tooling'}))]
	if [s for s in stateIdList if s in toolIds]:
		stateIdList = [s for s in stateIdList if s not in toolIds]
		self.toast({'type': 'warning', 'message': "Tool statuses can't be linked to an asset: Kanoa links them to tools."})

	for stateId in stateIdList:
		item = assetStates[stateId] if assetStates.has_key(stateId) else None
		if item is None: 
			stateIds.append(stateId)
			stateCode = max(stateCodeList or [-1]) + 1
			stateCodes.append(stateCode)
			stateCodeList.append(stateCode)

		elif not item['linkEnabled']: system.kanoa.asset.enableAssetStateLink(item['stateAssetLinkId'], True)
		else: system.perspective.print("No need to do anything, already linked and enabled")

	if len(stateIds) == 0: 
		self.toast({'type': 'warning', 'message': 'There are no states selected that need linking'})
		return

	self.view.custom.info = {"showBar": True, "text": "Linking assetId %s with stateId %s"%(assetId, stateIds), "type": "INFO"}
	system.perspective.print("linkAssetStates() called with %s %s %s %s"%([assetId], stateIds, userId, stateCodes))
	system.kanoa.asset.linkAssetStates([assetId], stateIds, userId, stateCodes)
	self.view.custom.info = {"showBar": False, "text": "", "type": "INFO"}
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.assetStates.data")
	self.toast({'type': 'success', 'message': 'Asset links have been updated'})

	return

customMethods.name: deleteSelected
customMethods.script:
userId = self.view.custom.security.userId
	selection = self.view.custom.states.selection
	SEP = '\\'
	
	def under(path, categoryPath):
		return path is not None and (path == categoryPath or path.startswith(categoryPath + SEP))
	
	#Every state, untranslated: the names are read before the delete (the rows are gone afterwards) and a category's
	#states are found by path. A selected category's states, and its sub-categories' states, are deleted with it
	states = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToJSON(system.kanoa.asset.getStates({}))
	stateNames = dict((row['stateId'], row['stateName']) for row in states)
	categoryPaths = sorted(set(selection['stateCategoryPaths']), key=len)
	stateIds = list(selection['stateIds'])
	for row in states:
		if any(under(row['stateCategoryPath'], path) for path in categoryPaths): stateIds.append(row['stateId'])
	
	deleted = 0
	disabled = []
	failed = []
	kept = set()	#States still there after the delete: their categories can't be deleted
	for stateId in sorted(set(stateIds)):
		name = stateNames.get(stateId) or str(stateId)
		retVal, response = system.kanoa.asset.deleteState(stateId, userId)
		if response == 'Deleted': deleted += 1
		elif response == 'Disabled':
			disabled.append(name)
			kept.add(stateId)
		else:
			failed.append('Couldn\'t delete state "%s": %s' % (name, response))	#A reserved state, or a database error
			kept.add(stateId)
	
	if categoryPaths:
		stateCategories = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetToDict(system.kanoa.asset.getStateCategory({}), 'stateCategoryPath', 'stateCategoryId')
		done = []
		for path in categoryPaths:
			if any(under(path, parent) for parent in done): continue	#Deleted with a selected parent
			left = len([row for row in states if row['stateId'] in kept and under(row['stateCategoryPath'], path)])
			if left:
				failed.append('State category "%s" was kept: %s of its states %s' % (path, left, 'is still in it' if left == 1 else 'are still in it'))
				continue
			retVal, msg = system.kanoa.asset.deleteStateCategory(stateCategories.get(path), userId)
			if msg: failed.append('Couldn\'t delete state category "%s": %s' % (path, msg))
			else:
				deleted += 1
				done.append(path)
	
	#One toast for the action, and only when something wasn't simply deleted (a deleted row disappears from the list)
	notes = list(failed)
	if len(disabled) == 1: notes.append('State "%s" has history, so it was disabled instead of deleted' % disabled[0])
	elif disabled:
		names = ', '.join('"%s"' % name for name in disabled[:3]) + (' and %s more' % (len(disabled) - 3) if len(disabled) > 3 else '')
		notes.append('%s states have history, so they were disabled instead of deleted: %s' % (len(disabled), names))
	if notes:
		toastType = 'error' if (deleted == 0 and not disabled) else 'warning'
		self.toast({'type': toastType, 'message': '; '.join(notes)})
	
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.states.data")
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.assetStates.data")
	self.view.custom.states.selection = {'stateIds': [], 'stateCategoryPaths': []}
	
	return

customMethods.name: toast
customMethods.script:
'''One toast at a time on this view. The first one's id is kept; every later toast updates it while it's showing, and shows it again under
	the same id once it has closed (a show with the id of a toast still showing is ignored, so the two never stack) (868mvvzbz).'''
	params = dict(params)
	toastId = self.view.custom.toastId
	if toastId:
		params['id'] = toastId
		system.kanoa.toast.update(params)
		system.kanoa.toast.show(params)
	else:
		self.view.custom.toastId = system.kanoa.toast.show(params)

system.perspective.print("updateStates msg rcvd with %s"%payload)
	self.view.refreshBinding("custom.states.data")
	#The tree reads the categories itself, and a new category with no states leaves the states data unchanged, so its
	#binding would not run again: refresh it so the new category is in the tree to be selected (868mu329h)
	self.view.getChild("root").getChild("flxStates").getChild("flxStateEditor").getChild("evStateTree").refreshBinding("props.params.values.data")
	
	if payload.get('stateCategoryId'):
		stateCategoryPath = system.kanoa.utilities.getFieldValue('stateCategoryPath', system.kanoa.asset.getStateCategory({'stateCategoryId': payload['stateCategoryId']}))
		self.view.custom.states.selection = {'stateIds': [], 'stateCategoryPaths': [stateCategoryPath]}
		#The tree selects it too, so the tree and the editor agree on the path (868mu329h). The tree applies it once the refreshed
		#data has the new category
		if stateCategoryPath: system.perspective.sendMessage('setTreeSelection', {'msgHandler': 'stateSelected', 'ids': [stateCategoryPath]})
	
	return

# implement your handler here
	system.perspective.print('stateDropped() called with payload: %s'%payload)

#	system.perspective.print("assetDropped() msg rcvd with draggedItem %s | droppedItem %s"%(payload['draggedItem']['assetPath'], payload['droppedItem']['assetPath']))
	statePath = payload['draggedItem']['statePath']
	if statePath is None: return
	
	if not self.view.custom.userAction.canCreate:
		system.perspective.print("User action not allowed. sending refreshTreeSelector() msg")
		self.view.refreshBinding('custom.states.data')		
		self.toast({'type': 'success', 'message': 'User action not allowed'})
		return
			
	draggedItem = payload['draggedItem']
	droppedItem = payload['droppedItem'] if payload['droppedItem'] is not None else {'parentId': None, 'assetId': None, 'assetPath': 'root level'}

	#The tool statuses and their folder stay where they are, and nothing goes into the folder (868mwzgc8)
	def inToolFolder(item):
		path = item.get('statePath') or ''
		return path == 'Tool statuses' or path.startswith('Tool statuses\\')
	if inToolFolder(draggedItem) or inToolFolder(droppedItem):
		self.toast({'type': 'warning', 'message': "Tool statuses can't be moved, and nothing can be moved into their folder."})
		self.view.refreshBinding('custom.states.data')
		return

	system.perspective.print("draggedItem['stateCategoryId'] - %sdraggedItem['stateId'] - %s droppedItem['stateCategoryId'] - %s"%(draggedItem['stateCategoryId'], draggedItem['stateId'], droppedItem['stateCategoryId']))
	
	# First handle disallowed drag and drops
	if droppedItem['stateId'] is not None:
		self.toast({'type': 'error', 'message': 'Cannot drop a state/state category onto a state.'})
	else:
		self.updateStateParent(draggedItem, droppedItem)
	self.view.refreshBinding('custom.states.data')
	return

system.perspective.print("confirmMoveState() msg rcvd with %s"%payload)
	
	draggedItem = payload['inputPayload']['draggedItem']
	droppedItem = payload['inputPayload']['droppedItem']
	
	if payload['userInput'] == 'OK':

		assetInfo = system.kanoa.utilities.convertDatasetRowToJSON(system.kanoa.asset.getAssets({'assetId': draggedItem['assetId']}),0)
		assetInfo['parentId'] = droppedItem['assetId'] if droppedItem is not None else None
		
		system.perspective.print("Moving %s to parentId %s"%(assetInfo['assetPath'],  assetInfo['parentId']))
		
		retVal, msg = system.kanoa.asset.updateAsset(assetInfo, self.view.custom.security.userId)
		if msg: self.toast({'type': 'error', 'message': 'Asset was not moved. %s'%msg})
		else: self.toast({'type': 'success', 'message': 'Asset has been moved'})
	else:
		system.perspective.sendMessage("refreshTreeSelector", {'search': ''})

	self.selectAsset(None)
	self.view.custom.assets.refreshTree = True
	system.perspective.sendMessage('clearTreeSelection', {})

	self.view.refreshBinding('custom.assets.data')
	
	return
